{{Top}} {{Otheruses}} {{Character |type= |image=[[File:Rane-Choice.png]] |name=Rane |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[148 BBY]], [[Brendok]]{{TheAcolyteDate}} The events of "[[Choice]]," during which Rane is stated to have [[Death|died]] on [[Brendok]] in the [[Disney+]] audio description, are stated to have taken place sixteen [[Standard year|years]] prior to the rest of the series, which equates to [[148 BBY]]. |species=[[Human]]{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} |gender=[[Gender|Female]] |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]]{{Acolyte|Choice}} |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Brendok coven]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|You would sacrifice our future for the wish of a child?|Rane, to Aniseya|audio=Rane-Future-Choice.flac|}} '''Rane''' was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[witch]] within the [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]] in a [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]]. Serving as an [[ensign]] and an [[advisor]], Rane attended the [[Rite of Ascension]] for Aniseya's [[twin]] [[Youngling|daughters]], [[Verosha Aniseya|Verosha]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae-ho]] in [[148 BBY]]. The ceremony was [[Mission to Brendok|interrupted]] by a group of [[Jedi]] concerned about the witches training of the twins. Rane accused them of wishing to steal the children, but the Jedi denied this and asked to test if the twins could be tested to become Jedi, to which Aniseya agreed. After Verosha chose to pass her test and declared that she wished to become a Jedi, Rane objected to the idea of letting the child leave, but Mother Aniseya chose to honor her child's wishes. Two of the Jedi then infiltrated the fortress, and Mother Aniseya was [[Death|killed]] in a confrontation with them, after which Rane and a group of witches in the fortress's common room cast a spell to control the [[Wookiee]] [[Jedi]] [[Kelnacca]], forcing him to fight his comrades. When [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] broke the witches' control over Kelnacca, it killed Rane and the others casting the spell. ==Biography== ===Singing in the Rane=== {{Quote|The power of one
The power of two
The power of many|Koril leads the witches in song|audio=PowerOfOne-Destiny.flac|}} [[File:RaneRitual-Destiny.png|thumb|right|300px|Rane took part in Verosha and Mae-ho Aniseya's Rite of Ascension.]] Rane was a [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]] member of a [[Brendok coven|coven]] of [[witch]]es led by [[Mother (title)|Mother]] [[Aniseya]] on the [[planet]] [[Brendok]], serving as an [[ensign]] and a [[advisor]]. In [[148 BBY]], Rane walked through the courtyard of the coven's [[mountain]] [[Brendok fortress|fortress]] with fellow Ensign [[Eurus]] carrying [[staff]]s and followed by several other witches as the [[twin]]s [[Verosha Aniseya]] and [[Mae-ho Aniseya]], the [[Youngling|daughters]] of Aniseya and Mother [[Koril]], entered the fortress. The children waved to Rane and Eurus, who then left the courtyard via a set of stone steps. In preparation for the twins [[Rite of Ascension]] later that [[Local day|night]], Rane and many other witches gathered by a hole in the mountain at the base of the fortress and took part in a ritual of syncronized [[Limb|arm]] movements{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} {{AD|Disney+}} led by Koril. It ended with the group bowing before Mother Aniseya as she approached from the rear and then made her way through the crowd to begin the rite with a speech. The twins then joined her by the hole in the mountain, and Koril led Rane and the other witches in [[Music|song]] and futher arm movements. Mother Aniseya completed the rite for Mae-ho, but before she could do so for Verosha, Eurus and the [[scout]] [[Sarria]] interrupted the ceremony to bring warning that a group of [[Jedi]] had [[Slicer|sliced]] the fortress's entry platform and were fast [[Mission to Brendok|approaching]]. ===When it Ranes it pours=== {{Quote|They want to take our children!|Rane|audio=Rane-TakeChildren-Destiny.flac|}} [[File:RaneShout-Destiny.png|thumb|left|300px|Rane accused the Jedi of trying to steal the coven's children.]] The witches then moved forward to conceal the twins behind them, with Rane ending up near the back of the group with Eurus. The four Jedi then entered and introduced themselves before revealing that they were concerned that the coven were training children. Aniseya initially tried to conceal the twins' presence, but when the Jedi [[Kelnacca]] sensed them in the crowd, [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] called for them to reveal themselves. Verosha did so, with Mae-ho following once Mother Aniseya gave permission. When [[Jedi Knight]] [[Sol]] noticed a mark that Mae-ho had received in the rite and declared that she had not had it that morning, Koril accused the Jedi of spying, and Rane cried out that they were there to [[Thief|steal]] the children. Sol denied Rane's claim and then offered Verosha his [[Sol's lightsaber|lightsaber]], asking if she would like to be tested to become a Jedi. Mother Aniseya then took control of Indara's [[Padawan]] [[Torbin]] using [[the Force]], demanding the Jedi leave if they wished for him to be freed. However, after Verosha asked to be tested, Mother Aniseya relented and released Torbin before agreeing that the Jedi could test the twins the following [[Standard day|day]]. Satisfied, the Jedi left, and Mother Aniseya ordered Koril to gather her advisors, including Rane. [[File:WitchAdvisors-Destiny.png|thumb|right|300px|Rane attended a discussion of what to do about the Jedi on Brendok.]] Rane and the others gathered in the fortress's common room, where Koril suggested that they attack the Jedi that very night. Mother Aniseya declared that they must let the twins be tested, but Koril objected until Elder [[Naasa]] interjected. Rane moved out of the way to let Naasa pass as the elder approached the [[Parent|mothers]], pointing out that the twins would only be taken by the Jedi if they passed the test. Aniseya then told Verosha and Mae-ho to intentionally fail the test, but Verosha chose to ignore her mothers' wishes and passed. ===Rane on her parade=== {{Quote|She is a child. The girl has yet to discover the power she holds. It's not her decision to make.''"
"''But is it ours?|Rane and Mother Aniseya discuss Verosha Aniseya|audio=Rane-Aniseya-Choice.flac|}} [[File:RaneObjects-Choice.png|thumb|left|300px|Rane objected to Verosha Aniseya joining the Jedi.]] Rane sat with Eurus in the common room as the twins reported the results of the test to Mother Aniseya and Koril, with Verosha admitting she wished to be a Jedi and not a witch. Mother Aniseya promised to take Verosha's wishes into account and then sent her away, after which Rane and the other witches present rose to discuss what should be done about Verosha with Mother Aniseya. Rane immediately objected to Verosha leaving, claiming she was too young to know how powerful she truly was and that it was not her choice to make. In response, Mother Aniseya wondered if it was right for them to ignore Verosha's wishes and choose for her, causing Rane to accuse her of sacrificing the coven's future over a child's wishes. Despite this, Mother Aniseya choses to respect her daughter's wishes. ===Rane drops=== {{Listen3|Witches-TranceChant-Choice.flac|The witches' chant|Rane and the other witches chant while casting a spell on Kelnacca}} Meanwhile, Mother Koril had told the other witches outside the common room to arm themselves and Sol and Torbin had infiltrated the fortress seeking to rescue the twins. Aniseya left the room, but she was [[Death|killed]] by Sol during a confrontation in the courtyard, after which Rane and the other witches in the common room cast a spell{{Acolyte|Choice}} {{AD|Disney+}} to take control of Kelnacca when he{{Databank|kelnacca|Kelnacca}} entered the fortress as Aniseya had previously controlled Torbin. [[File:RaneCorpse-Destiny.png|thumb|right|300px|Rane was killed when Indara broke the coven's spell controlling Kelnacca.]] Entering a trance-like state of concentration, Rane and the others sat mumbling a chant while swaying with their palms raised and their [[eye]]s fully [[Color|black]]. Kelnacca fought Sol and Torbin till Indara arrived and used the Force to free him from the witches' control. This killed Rane and the other witches casting the spell, causing them to fall into a lifeless heap. After Sol then saved Verosha from a [[fire]] in the fortress, she saw Rane's corpse as she and the Jedi fled. ==Personality and traits== Rane objected to Verosha joining the Jedi and prioritized the coven's future over the child's own wishes. The ensign had light skin, brown [[hair]], and brown eyes. ==Equipment== Rane wore green [[robe]]s over a brown [[Clothing|shirt]] with a copper-colored pentagonal emblem on a [[necklace]] and also carried a staff. At the twins' Rite of Ascension, Rane wore a ceremonial purple cloak with a gold trim. ==Behind the scenes== ===Auditioning and building a character=== Rane first appeared in "[[Destiny (The Acolyte)|Destiny]]," the third episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired [[June 11]], [[2024]], on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}} The character was portrayed by [[Amy Tsang]], and although Rane's name was not spoken in the episode, it was listed in the credits. Tsang sent in an audition tape for the role using dummy sides for another character after her friend [[Jeff King]], an executive producer on the series, saw her in an indie film and suggested that she would be a good fit for Rane. She learned she had gotten the role three months after the audition{{WebCite|url=https://www.studentpages.biz/the-acolytes-ensign-a-journey-with-amy-tsang|text=The Acolyte’s Ensign: A journey with Amy Tsang|author=Wieland, Gabriella|date=2024-11-07|archivedate=20241206180650}} and began filming two weeks later in [[Wikipedia:London|London]].{{WebCite|url=https://heroichollywood.com/amy-tsang-the-acolyte-indie-projects-star-wars-witches-interview|text=Amy Tsang Talks ‘The Acolyte’, Indie Projects, and ‘Star Wars’ Witches (INTERVIEW)|author=Singletary, Anthony|date=2024-07-02|archivedate=20240723083823}} Tsang was given little information about the character and initially only had a codename. She read up on previous depictions of [[Nightsisters|witches]] in ''[[Star Wars]]'' but felt they were different to Aniseya's coven and so also drew on [[In-universe|out-of-universe]] witchcraft and films like [[Wikipedia:The Craft (film)|''The Craft'']]. Recieving only the scripts for her scenes, she used material from the art team including the costume, hair, and makeup designs to understand the character from the outside in.{{WebCite|url=https://screenrant.com/the-acolyte-star-wars-amy-tsang-episode-7-interview|text=The Acolyte’s Amy Tsang Talks Joining Star Wars And A Coven of Brendok Witches|author=Danoff, Owen|date=2024-07-12|archivedate=20240713155242}} Costumer designner [[Jennifer Bryan]] was very specific with the design for each individual witch. Rane's costume was very structured with a high neck, making Tsang stand straight and so informed how she moved around in the world. ===Movement and filming=== {{Quote|I worked with a movement coach named Alex Reynolds, who is amazing. She had me do things like walk through a park in winter to connect with nature and develop a wide peripheral vision. It was all about getting into the body of the character. The costumes also helped a lot, and I created a playlist to get into the mindset while driving to set every day.|Amy Tsang|{{WebCite|url=https://bamsmackpow.com/posts/exclusive-the-acolyte-s-amy-tsang-talks-la-weather-star-wars-and-what-she-d-name-her-own-lightsaber-01j297090z51|text=EXCLUSIVE: The Acolyte's Amy Tsang talks LA weather, Star Wars, and what she'd name her own lightsaber|author=Domingues, Camila|date=2024-07-09|archivedate=20240716023454}}}} Movement coach [[Alex Reynolds]] worked with Tsang to help her get into the body of the character and had her connect with nature by walking through a park in winter and developing a wider peripheral vision. The actress also put together a playlist to get into the mindset of Rane to listen to on the way to work each day and found that the costume helped as well Tsang also had a chance to speak with show runner [[Leslye Headland]] about the character before filming her first scene and has said discussions with episode director [[Kogonada]] also helped shape Rane. Tsang primarily describes Rane as a noble character who is protective both of the twins and of her coven, seeking to live in peace. She sees the character as siding more with Mother Koril then Mother Aniseya.{{YouTube|video=xvKbK1amb7U|text=Amy Tsang – Star Wars The Acolyte – Interview|channel=JimConlanChats|name=Jim Conlan Chats|date=2024-06-22}} Tsang and the other witch actors filmed the Ascension Ceremony scenes first, rehearsing for days with a pre-composed song for the chant playing in the background with the rehearsal.{{WebCite|url=https://comicbook.com/tv-shows/news/the-acolyte-amy-tsang-talks-joining-the-star-wars-universe|text=The Acolyte: Amy Tsang Talks Joining the Star Wars Universe|author=Drum, Nicole|date=2024-06-24|archivedate=20240723083823}} These shoots took place outside on an almost entirely practical set and at one point they shot under a full moon. Each witch moved in a distinct way that Reynolds worked on with Tsang personally for Rane and various images and movements were shown to the cast to draw on including ideas of African tribal dances. On the last day of filming, Mother Aniseya actress [[Jodie Turner-Smith]] recorded a [[Wikipedia:TikTok|TikTok]] video of Rane and the other witches dancing in costume on a production phone, although it has not yet been released. Tsang and the other witch actors each had their own backstories for the characters beyond what was shown on screen and she has said she would love to portray the character again in a prequel series. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Rane}} *{{Acolyte|Choice}} *{{Acolyte|Destiny (The Acolyte)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|Py_IYpy4IlQ|The Acolyte | Plan | Streaming June 4 on Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|9DItelHk3ng|The Acolyte Launch Event Recap}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|WaZsA97XgaE|The Acolyte | Michael Abels - Ascension Ceremony | Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{SWYouTube|9ajCIM6U5UA|The Acolyte | The Costumes of The Acolyte | Disney+}} {{Video}} *{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'' {{Po}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Rane |ka=რეინი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Brendok coven]]
